summary: This is a documentation/planning-only change to the ai-os ops repo: a gap-analysis re-verification (VERIDIAN_ARCHITECTURE_V2_GAP_ANALYSIS_2026-07-25.yaml), a corresponding phase-plan rescope (VERIDIAN_ARCHITECTURE_V2_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-25.yaml), and a mechanical regeneration of WIRING_ENGINE_REGISTRY_2026-07-25.json. No application code, schema/migrations, auth/permission/payment/security paths, or .github/workflows files are touched, so this is correctly tier1 (additive docs/config, no code execution surface). I independently verified the substantive claims rather than trusting the self-report: (1) the huge WIRING_ENGINE_REGISTRY_2026-07-25.json diff (15,126 changed lines) is, on programmatic diffing of entity_id sets, purely additive -- 13 new knowledge-engine entities added, 0 removed, 0 existing entities changed except timestamps (the size is an artifact of every entity's last_verified_ts being rewritten by a full regenerator run) -- consistent with the claimed 'reran scripts/generate_wiring_registry.py'. (2) The two headline-count assertions in the gap analysis (73 not_implemented + 32 partially_implemented = 105; all 12 changed_item_ids are indeed partially_implemented) check out arithmetically against the actual YAML content. (3) I spot-checked the core new prior-art claims (prompt_templates/prompt_versions registry, hasRole('veridian_admin') gating, recordAuditTrigger call, pgvector cosine-similarity 0.95-threshold semantic cache in instruction-execution-cache-service.ts/embeddings.ts) directly against repos/compliance-tracker source and they are accurate, not fabricated -- and the claim that scripts/superboss-register.py has no 'list-entities' subcommand (used to correct an invalid old success_criteria command) is also verified true against its actual argparse subcommands. The rescoping of phase_1 away from a new SQLite prompt_registry table toward extending the real, live Postgres prompt_templates/prompt_versions tables is exactly the kind of duplication-avoidance the Owner's directive asked for, and is well-reasoned. One real but minor defect: VERIDIAN_ARCHITECTURE_V2_GAP_ANALYSIS_2026-07-25.yaml lines 598-599 contain a duplicate YAML mapping key (known_partial_prior_art_ref: llm_client appears twice in the engine-cost-optimization item, both with the identical value) -- an edit that added a new line without removing the old one. The file still parses fine under PyYAML (last value wins, and both values are identical so there's no information loss), but it is invalid YAML per spec and would fail under stricter/duplicate-key-checking parsers. This is cosmetic/sloppy rather than a correctness or security problem, so it does not change the approve verdict for this tier1 doc change, but should be cleaned up in a fast follow-up.
issues: Duplicate YAML mapping key in VERIDIAN_ARCHITECTURE_V2_GAP_ANALYSIS_2026-07-25.yaml lines 598-599: 'known_partial_prior_art_ref: llm_client' appears twice under the engine-cost-optimization item (leftover line not removed when the new one was added). Harmless under PyYAML (identical values, last one wins) but invalid YAML -- should be deduplicated in a follow-up edit.
